title: Saying “No” to Death Sticks
front_description: Obi-Wan and Anakin chase fleeing bounty hunter Zam into a local nightclub. "You don't want to sell me death sticks," Obi-Wan tells a sleazy merchant who approaches him at the bar. "I don't want to sell you death sticks," the weak—minded dealer repeats. "You want to go home and rethink your life," Kenobi continues. The death-stick pusher repeats this statement as well. Ilien he leaves the bar in a stupor as Obi-Wan downs his drink.
back_description: Full-size exterior set of the nightclub Anakin and Obi-Wan investigate
